info.title: Streaming Response
info.description:
seedream-5-0-lite/4.5/4.0 supports streaming output mode. When you call the image generation API and set **stream** to `true`, the server will push events to the client in real time via Server-Sent Events (SSE) while generating the response. This section describes the various events pushed by the server.

Only `seedream-5-0-lite`, `seedream-4-5`, and `seedream-4-0` support streaming responses.

post.description:
seedream-5-0-lite/4.5/4.0 supports streaming output mode. When you call the image generation API and set **stream** to `true`, the server will push events to the client in real time via Server-Sent Events (SSE) while generating the response.

The server will push the following events:

| Event Name | Trigger Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `image_generation.partial_succeeded` | Any image generated successfully | Pushes the generation result for a single image |
| `image_generation.partial_failed` | Any image generation failed | Pushes the failure reason |
| `image_generation.completed` | All images processed | Pushes usage information and marks the stream end |
| `error` | Request error occurred | Returns error information |

200.description:
SSE streaming response. Response type is `text/event-stream`.

## image_generation.partial_succeeded

> Currently only seedream-5-0-lite/4.5/4.0 supports streaming response.

Returned when any image is generated successfully in streaming response mode.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | Should be `image_generation.partial_succeeded` |
| `model` | string | The model ID used for this request, format is `<model name>-<version>` |
| `created` | integer | Unix timestamp (seconds) of when this request was created |
| `image_index` | integer | The index of the image corresponding to this event in the request, starting from `0`. The counter increments by 1 for both `image_generation.partial_succeeded` and `image_generation.partial_failed` events regardless of success or failure |
| `url` | string | Download URL of the image for this event. Returned when the `response_format` is set to `url` |
| `b64_json` | string | Base64-encoded image data for this event. Returned when the `response_format` is set to `b64_json` |
| `size` | string | Image dimensions in pixels, format `<width pixels>×<height pixels>`, e.g. `2048×2048` |

## image_generation.partial_failed

> Currently only seedream-5-0-lite/4.5/4.0 supports streaming response.

Returned when any image generation fails in streaming response mode.

- If the failure reason is content moderation failure: the next image generation task will still proceed, i.e., it does not affect the generation flow of other images in the same request.
- If the failure reason is an internal service error (500): the next image generation task will not proceed.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | Should be `image_generation.partial_failed` |
| `model` | string | The model ID used for this request, format is `<model name>-<version>` |
| `created` | integer | Unix timestamp (seconds) of when this request was created |
| `image_index` | integer | The index of the image corresponding to this event in the request, starting from `0`. The counter increments by 1 for both `image_generation.partial_succeeded` and `image_generation.partial_failed` events regardless of success or failure |
| `error` | object | The error reason for this event |
| `error.code` | string | Error code |
| `error.message` | string | Error message |

## image_generation.completed

> Currently only seedream-5-0-lite/4.5/4.0 supports streaming response.

Returned when all images (whether successful or failed) have been processed. This is the last response event of the streaming response.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | Should be `image_generation.completed` |
| `model` | string | The model ID used for this request, format is `<model name>-<version>` |
| `created` | integer | Unix timestamp (seconds) of when this request was created |
| `tools` | array of object | Tools configured for model invocation in this request |
| `tools[].type` | string | The type of tool configured. `web_search` is the web search tool |
| `usage` | object | Usage information for this request |
| `usage.generated_images` | integer | Number of images successfully generated by the model, excluding failed ones. Billing is based on the number of successfully generated images |
| `usage.output_tokens` | integer | Number of tokens consumed for the generated images. Calculated as `sum(image_width*image_height)/256` rounded down |
| `usage.total_tokens` | integer | Total number of tokens consumed for this request. Currently input tokens are not counted, so it matches `output_tokens` |
| `usage.tool_usage` | object | Usage information for tools used |
| `usage.tool_usage.web_search` | integer | Number of times the web search tool was called, only returned when web search is enabled |

## error

Error information returned when an error occurs in this request.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `error` | object | Error information returned for this request |
| `error.code` | string | Error code |
| `error.message` | string | Error message |
